p: Asaph: This Asaph was not the notable musician, but another of that name also called Ebiasaph in 1Ch 6:23,37,9:19 and also Jasaph.
blessed him: In giving him many children.
ruled throughout the house of their: Or, like their father's house, meaning, worthy men and valiant.
strength for the service: Fit to serve the office of the portership.
against another: According to their turns as well the one as the other.
a wise counsellor: One expert and fit to keep that gate.
Asuppim: This was a house where they used to resort to consult things concerning the temple, as a convocation house.
Shallecheth: At which they used to cast out the filth of the city.
two and two: Meaning two one day and two another.
Parbar westward: Which was a house in which they kept the instruments of the temple.
Amramites: These also had charge over the treasures.
dedicated: According as the Lord commanded, Nu 31:28.
over Israel: Meaning of things that were out of the city.
the king: That is, for the king's house.
God: Both in spiritual and temporal things.
